summary: std/native/llrt/rsa: the RSA private key operation's check of its result against the public operation compares in constant time (`ct.bytes_equal`, as Go's constant time Equal)
details: the RSA private key operation's check of its result against the public operation compares in constant time (`ct.bytes_equal`, as Go's constant time Equal); a `==` on Bytes could stop at the first differing byte.
